_doc: Every HTTP surface the Worker serves. `python3 -m foundation standards --check` fails when index.js serves a path that is not listed here, and the conformance tests fail when a discoverable surface is missing from /llms.txt, the OpenAPI document or the agent card. A new surface is registered here in the same change that adds it.

surfaces.description: Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, JSON responses). Tools: tick status, loop registry, glossary, dashboard state, standards register.
A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC interface (header A2A-Version: 1.0). SendMessage runs one read-only skill from the agent card and answers with a Message; no task is created.
Last tick result; 200 when every step of the last tick completed, 503 otherwise.
Plain-language index for language models.
How a code agent works with this organisation.
A2A agent card.
MCP server card (SEP-2127).
Agent Skills discovery index.
Skill: operate this organisation through its MCP tools.

RFC 9728 protected resource metadata for /mcp.

Event-driven trigger: HMAC-signed GitHub webhook (X-Hub-Signature-256) wakes the role named in doctrine/triggers.json; 401 on a bad signature.
surfaces.reason: machine-to-machine callback authenticated by HMAC; nothing for an agent to discover

surfaces.description: HOSTS-1: a hosting system reports a deploy or runtime event, HMAC-signed with HOST_WEBHOOK_SECRET; 401 on a bad signature.
surfaces.reason: machine-to-machine callback authenticated by HMAC; nothing for an agent to discover

surfaces.description: CF-ALERTS-1: Cloudflare posts an account alert with the destination secret in cf-webhook-auth; it becomes a CF-ALERT queue item; 401 on a bad secret.
surfaces.reason: machine-to-machine callback authenticated by a shared secret; nothing for an agent to discover

surfaces.description: Invokes every code-agent adapter once through the Workers AI binding and returns which answered (CODE-AGENTS-1).
surfaces.reason: operational probe for deploy verification, not a capability for callers

surfaces.description: Liveness plus k_eff of the last tick (CRITICALITY-1), the ignition stage from bootstrap to criticality (BOOT-KNOWS-1) and every loop's clock (LOOPPROOF-1).
surfaces.reason: operational criticality telemetry (CRITICALITY-1), not a capability for callers

surfaces.description: Criticality record of the last tick (CRITICALITY-1).
surfaces.reason: operational criticality telemetry (CRITICALITY-1), not a capability for callers

surfaces.description: Collectors push GitHub-run, cost and owner-touch samples (CRITICALITY-1).
surfaces.reason: machine-to-machine collector input; nothing for an agent to discover

surfaces.description: The second producer of the heartbeat (LOOPPROOF-1): leaves a watchdog beat and runs a tick only when the newest tick is older than two intervals.
surfaces.reason: machine-to-machine watchdog call from the site Worker's service binding; nothing for an agent to discover

surfaces.description: MAIN-WRITER-1: commits a workflow's data files to main with the org's GitHub App, after verifying the run's GitHub Actions OIDC token (audience ultrastable-main); protected paths are refused.
surfaces.reason: called only by tools/push_main.py inside this repository's workflows with a per-run token; nothing for an agent to discover

surfaces.description: UPTIME-1: redeploys the site (the fixed workflow deploy-site.yml on main) with the org's GitHub App when the uptime worker finds a dead hostname; takes no input and is throttled
surfaces.reason: called only by the ultrastable-uptime worker over a service binding; nothing for an agent to discover

surfaces.description: LANE-WORKER-MERGE-1: squash-merges a same-repository pull request that changes workflows with the org's GitHub App, after verifying the run's OIDC token, the exact head commit and the green guard
surfaces.reason: called only by tools/lane_worker_merge.py inside this repository's lane with a per-run token; nothing for an agent to discover

surfaces.description: BACKUP-SINK-1: the backup drill's dumps, written to the private ops repository under backups/ with the org's GitHub App after the run's OIDC token is verified
surfaces.reason: called only by foundation/workerroute.py inside the backup-drill workflow with a per-run token; nothing for an agent to discover

surfaces.description: Spend governor (SPEND-GOVERNOR-1): the owner's monthly budget (usd_per_month), the daily Workers AI allowance it buys, today's metered use, and the mode (normal, lean, frozen) with its reason.
AUDIT-CHAIN-1: chain head hash and sealed segment count; anyone can record it to anchor the audit trail.
AUDIT-CHAIN-1: recompute the hash chain and cross-check the D1 index against the archive (bearer; deep=1 reads segments).
surfaces.reason: Owner-only bearer route for operators; the audit trail is not an agent-facing surface.

surfaces.description: AUDIT-CHAIN-1: trace a ref or kind through hot rows and archived segments (bearer).
surfaces.reason: Owner-only bearer route for operators; the audit trail is not an agent-facing surface.

surfaces.description: Merged pull requests cached by the tick on every pass; the site overlays them on the daily snapshot (LIVE-FRESH-1).
surfaces.reason: internal feed read by the site worker over a service binding, not a capability for callers

surfaces.description: The judged release cadence of every system and the merged changes behind it; the site serves it as /progress, digests and an Atom feed (PROGRESS-1).
surfaces.reason: internal feed read by the site worker over a service binding, not a capability for callers

surfaces.description: The judged freshness, breadth, depth and diversity of every system's content, its plan and its daily series (STICKY-1).
surfaces.reason: internal feed read by the site worker over a service binding; the site serves it publicly at /api/stickiness

surfaces.description: The social queue of one system's entries not yet promoted, drained by the core social module through gate.tenant_queues (STICKY-1).
surfaces.reason: internal feed read by the site worker over a service binding and drained by the social module, not a capability for callers

surfaces.description: Worker-side decision points (AI router, free-tier governor): decisions in the last 7 days, scored, hit rate, trend (DECISIONS-1).
surfaces.reason: internal feed read by the site worker over a service binding; the public page and API are /decisions and /api/decisions on the site

surfaces.description: Pay-or-stay-free analysis from real free-tier usage and current Cloudflare prices; free-only is the default mode (ROI-1).
surfaces.reason: internal feed read by the owner dashboard and the site worker proxy; it recommends only and enables nothing

surfaces.description: Today's estimated Cloudflare bill, the soft daily spend target, the throttle level (full, ease, throttle, crawl) and its knobs; ?tenant= gives one tenant's share (SPEND-SOFT-1).
surfaces.reason: read by tenant workers and the site worker proxy; it reports state and enables nothing

surfaces.description: GOALS-1: every goal (mission, objective, target) with value, target, trend, the knobs, recent knob changes and every loop with whether it closed.
surfaces.reason: internal feed read by the site worker over a service binding; the public page and API are /goals and /api/goals on the site

surfaces.description: GOALS-1: current knob values for one tenant (?tenant=); the tenant applies them in its own code.
surfaces.reason: tenant interface: read by tenant Workers, not an agent-facing surface

surfaces.description: GOALS-1: a tenant registers its goals and knobs (bearer).
surfaces.reason: tenant interface with bearer auth; not an agent-facing surface

surfaces.description: GOALS-1: a tenant reports readings for its goals (bearer).
surfaces.reason: tenant interface with bearer auth; not an agent-facing surface
Read by foundation code and the owner page; to be exposed as an MCP tool in a later contract version.
surfaces.description: OWNER-ACTS-1: sign-ins a provider refused and open gate cards, read live from the credential rows; JSON, no secret values.
SOCIAL-MODULE-1: token-gated hand-over of a channel token into the sealed credential store; answers names only, never values.
surfaces.reason: Machine-to-machine bearer route for moving a channel login into the system; not a capability for callers.

surfaces.description: The knowledge graph of this system's own data: last pass summary (counts by kind, hubs, communities, bridges, orphans) and its series; the public view veils records of kinds not declared public (DATAGRAPH-1).
surfaces.reason: served by the tick Worker; the site serves /api/graph and /api/graph/insights publicly over a service binding

surfaces.description: KGRAPH-AI-1: the knowledge graph's AI layer: today's neuron cost against its share, embedded node count and community summaries.
surfaces.reason: served by the tick Worker; a cost probe for the graph's Workers AI use

surfaces.description: Open findings of the knowledge graph (orphaned kinds, bridges, new hubs, fragmentation) and link leads awaiting confirmation by later data (DATAGRAPH-1).
surfaces.reason: served by the tick Worker; the site serves /api/graph and /api/graph/insights publicly over a service binding

surfaces.description: One record of the knowledge graph and its neighbourhood (depth 1 or 2), the local context for retrieval; public kinds only without the owner bearer (DATAGRAPH-1).
surfaces.reason: served by the tick Worker; the site serves /api/graph and /api/graph/insights publicly over a service binding

surfaces.description: Label search over the knowledge graph; public kinds only without the owner bearer (DATAGRAPH-1).
surfaces.reason: served by the tick Worker; the site serves /api/graph and /api/graph/insights publicly over a service binding

surfaces.description: The knowledge graph of this system's data in plain words: size, what the system noticed, most connected records, how connected each kind is (DATAGRAPH-1).
surfaces.reason: served by the tick Worker; the site serves /api/graph and /api/graph/insights publicly over a service binding

surfaces.description: Every plan the goal planner keeps, its task tree and its gate verdict (PLAN-1).
surfaces.reason: read of the goal planner's plans for the site worker and the owner screen (PLAN-1); not advertised to agents
